Class EventModel

All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AlienCabinTilesEvent, BatteriesUpdateEvent, BatteryDecisionEvent, BoardTypeUpdateEvent, CannonSelectionEvent, CardDecisionEvent, CardFinishedEvent, CardPickedEvent, CardsReturnedEvent, CardsTakenEvent, CardStatusEvent, CargoDecisionEvent, CargoSwappedEvent, CargoUnloadedEvent, CargoUpdateEvent, CreditsUpdateEvent, CrewDecisionEvent, CrewUpdateEvent, DecisionEndEvent, DiceThrowEvent, DoneBuildingEvent, EngineSelectionEvent, GameOverEvent, GameResetEvent, GameStateUpdateEvent, InvalidShipEvent, PlanetChosenEvent, PlanetRefusedEvent, PlanetSelectionEvent, PlayerEliminatedEvent, PlayerPositionUpdateEvent, PlayerScoreEvent, PlayerStatusEvent, PlayersUpdateEvent, ProjectileEvent, ShipUpdateEvent, TileReturnedEvent, TileTakenEvent, TimerFinishedEvent, TimerStartEvent
public abstract class EventModel extends Object implements Serializable
The base class for all model events in the application.

All specific event types should extend this class. Being Serializable allows these events to be sent over a network or saved if necessary.
